description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing, a pointing marker used in the Image_Graph PHP library for rendering graphical markers with start and end points, offsets, and drawing capabilities.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing
classes.description: A class representing a pointing marker with start and end markers, offsets, and drawing logic.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pointing
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pointing marker with offsets and end marker.

methods.name: setMarkerStart
methods.description: Sets the starting marker (tip of the pin) and assigns its parent.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker on the canvas, including start marker, line, and end marker.
